'''Neiya Chault''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] supporter of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thoma]] went on a mission to investigate alien mercenaries that joined the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], she asked a Republic spacer to search for the missing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the Mercenary Training Facility Barracks. The Republic spacer found Thoma dead, but retrieved a message he left for Neiya.<ref name="TOR" />

In the message, Thoma revealed that Neiya was Force-sensitive and expressed his desire that his friend receive training from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. After seeing the holocron, Neiya agreed to honor his wish.<ref name="TOR" />
